name: Geekbench: Text Processing
description: Loads 190 markdown files, parses the contents using regular expressions, stores metadata in a SQLite database, and exports the content to a different format on an in-memory encrypted file system, using a mix of C++ and Python.The score is calibrated against a baseline score of 2,500 (Dell Precision 3460 with a Core i7-12700 processor) as per the Geekbench 6 Benchmark Internals.
note: This benchmark uses a fixed workload size and does not scale with vCPU count beyond 4 vCPUs, so it is not recommended for evaluating larger instance sizes.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
environment_fields.duration: Duration (seconds) of the benchmarking framework run that produced this score, shared by all benchmarks and configs of that run.
